title: Flatten deeply nested branches
rationale: High nesting raises branch complexity and hurts maintainability and performance tuning.
actions: Introduce guard clauses to exit early.
Extract nested blocks into focused helper functions.
Merge related conditions where possible.

conditions.hint: Code smell detector flagged deep nesting.

title: Split long function into smaller units
rationale: Large functions reduce optimization locality and hide hot-path opportunities.
actions: Extract independent regions into helper functions.
Isolate hot path from setup/cleanup code.
Keep each helper focused on one responsibility.

title: Reduce pass-by-value copy hotspots
rationale: Unnecessary copies increase CPU and memory pressure on critical paths.
actions: Switch heavy pass-by-value parameters to const references.
Use move semantics when ownership transfer is intended.
Profile copy-heavy call sites after change.

title: Stabilize memory management paths
rationale: Risky allocation patterns can block aggressive optimization and introduce leaks.
actions: Balance allocation/deallocation paths.
Prefer RAII wrappers and smart pointers.
Replace unsafe C-string APIs with bounded alternatives.

title: Replace magic numbers with named constants
rationale: Named constants improve readability and help compiler optimizations reason about intent.
actions: Introduce constexpr constants for repeated literals.
Group related constants into enums or structs.
Keep units and intent in constant names.

title: Extract duplicate blocks into shared logic
rationale: Duplicate blocks multiply maintenance and optimization effort.
actions: Extract duplicate blocks into one shared helper.
Parameterize variable behavior points.
Keep one canonical implementation path.

title: Remove dead and unused work
rationale: Dead paths and unused values add noise and reduce optimizer effectiveness.
actions: Delete unreachable statements after terminators.
Remove or intentionally annotate unused variables.
Re-run compile diagnostics after cleanup.

title: Modernize container loops with STL-friendly patterns
rationale: Modern loop and STL patterns reduce overhead and enable better compiler optimizations.
actions: Use range-based loops where indexing is not needed.
Prefer standard algorithms for common traversal patterns.
Pass containers by const reference when mutation is unnecessary.
